metadata.name: launch-custom-command-executes
metadata.description: Launch a terminal with a custom command and verify launched session connectivity

assert.failure_message: Expected launched session ID to be captured for output checks

evaluate.expression: (() => { const sessionId = localStorage.getItem('bas.terminalSmoke.sessionId') || ''; const outputMap = window.__bas_ws_output || {}; const hasSessionTraffic = sessionId ? typeof outputMap[sessionId] === 'string' : false; document.body.setAttribute('data-terminal-traffic-ok', hasSessionTraffic ? 'true' : 'false'); })()

metadata.label: Mark websocket traffic via tracked sockets

assert.failure_message: Expected terminal websocket traffic after running a command

evaluate.expression: (async () => { let seen = false; const sessionId = localStorage.getItem('bas.terminalSmoke.sessionId') || ''; const deadline = Date.now() + 8000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const pane = sessionId ? document.querySelector(`[data-testid='terminal-pane'][data-session-id='${sessionId}']`) : document.querySelector('[data-testid="terminal-pane"][data-session-id]'); const paneText = pane ? (pane.textContent || '') : ''; const outputMap = window.__bas_ws_output || {}; const wsText = sessionId ? (outputMap[sessionId] || '') : ''; if (paneText.includes('BAS_E2E_TERMINAL_OK') || wsText.includes('BAS_E2E_TERMINAL_OK')) { seen = true; break; } await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100)); } document.body.setAttribute('data-terminal-output-ok', seen ? 'true' : 'false'); })()
